name: Ben Quayle
summary:
Benjamin Eugene Quayle (born November 5, 1976) is an American lawyer and politician who is a former U.S. representative for Arizona's 3rd congressional district. A member of the Republican Party, he is the son of the 44th vice president of the United States, Dan Quayle.
Before serving in Congress, Quayle worked as an associate lawyer and founded a security company.
